task.goal: Make Doré own and continuously run the Storybook design-lab loop without requiring ChatGPT peer on ordinary design research iterations.
task.authority: User explicitly approved: 改成讓多雷自己跑
preserve: three materially distinct Storybook homepage directions
required_behavior: For continuous Storybook/design-lab goals, RESEARCH_REQUIRED must first remain inside Doré autonomous self-research rather than immediately becoming PEER_RESEARCH_QUEUED.

Doré must autonomously search local Knowledge Lab, source catalog, maintained OSS/GitHub and other already-available research capabilities; normalize and checkpoint new references; choose hypotheses; generate Storybook specimens; build; verify; reject/promote; and continue without user input.

If an iteration does not meet the 40-reference/6-family/3-direction acceptance gate, keep the parent ACTIVE and start a materially different self-research iteration with information gain. Do not treat a successful Storybook build as completion of the research parent.

Use A2A peer escalation only after Doré has exhausted materially different self-research hypotheses or hits a capability/permission boundary that local tools cannot resolve. Ordinary reference expansion and design iteration are not peer gates.
If the current research job is already PEER_RESEARCH_QUEUED solely because the reference threshold is unmet, reclaim it into Doré self-research and continue the exact parent goal.
Do not modify the locked approved #262 homepage while running the laboratory. Storybook is the experiment surface.
acceptance: A continuous Storybook design-lab parent does not stop at PEER_RESEARCH_QUEUED merely because reference/family thresholds are unmet.
Current design-reference-library-expansion-20260901 is reclaimed from A2A_WAITING_PEER into an autonomous Doré research/experiment state.
At least one no-user-input autonomous iteration executes after the policy change.
Storybook static build remains PASS when an experiment is produced.
Telemetry shows Doré progressing without PEER_RESPONSE_REQUIRED for ordinary Storybook research.
Canonical result is written to coordination-outbox/result-storybook-dore-autonomous-loop-1.json with evidence.
